what: A 0.6px grid fixed to the screen (8 cells at 1440 width·4 on phone, square cells divided after subtracting 16/1440·8/400 at the edges, passing through the screen center) is drawn with a WebGL shader. When called, concentric ripples rise from the center and settle over .8s with sin(πt) (push max 10px·twist, frequency .01·speed 8·radius 2100) while the lines darken from .1 to .2, and when the zoom step changes the cells double over 2s quart.out. At each intersection a 2px character flips every 1 second and hides during the ripple. Over a front target an inverse-color grid overlaps in its exact shape.
ease: none (wave strength sin(πt)) · quart.out (cell enlarge) · cubic-bezier(.26,.06,0,1) .5s (letter hide)

options.amp: Ripple strength, default .1 (push = amp × strength px)
options.intro: Ripple length when sticking (s), default 1 — 0 means none
options.zoom: Zoom level of this page (divides the number of cells), default 1
options.remember: Key name — when given, carries the zoom step from the previous page over to this page’s step (sessionStorage)
options.letters: Intersection text line (none for no text), default LOGOTYPEGRIDLINES
options.front: CSS target to overlay the inverted-color grid on — shaped like the clip-path polygon of the first visible target (or its box if none)
options.Event fx:grid-ripple-bg: detail on an element or document { pulse: true|seconds, amp, zoom: steps, zoomDur: seconds } — Apply wave and zoom
options.--fx-front-color: Front grid color, default --kf-contrast-ink. The back grid color is the element’s color (default --kf-ink)

use: — Body is position:relative; on top with z-index:1. When the photo changes, document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fx:grid-ripple-bg', { detail: { pulse: true } })). three loads this folder’s three-global.js ahead of library/_vendor/three@0.184.0/build/three.cjs and receives it as window.THREE

from.where: shared.js grid background (original Brand grid — three r184 shader · ripple on each hero photo change · company scene · careers slider · page transition, the News list has double cells)

note: When there is no ripple or zoom, it does not redraw (still frame). The front layer follows only one visible target — the original merges an SVG clipPath per target. Text is a placeholder text line instead of the original copy
